title: Aurora in the 1986 budget

tellings.quote: There's a 1968, or sorry, 1986 budget, uh where it shows up as a line item for I think it like $2 billion or something

plain: Aurora, a name tied to a rumoured secret US aircraft, is said to show up as a line item of roughly $2 billion in the 1986 US budget. Michels says this himself on an episode with the journalist Nick Cook, first saying 1968 and then correcting himself, and he mentions the aircraft engineer Ben Rich and British Ministry of Defence documents in the same breath. If true, a budget line would be a paper trail for a project officially never acknowledged.
